b: The 59th edition of the furniture fair will feature 430,000 sq m of exhibition space, 2,700 exhibitors and new zones covering senior living, pet furniture and smart upholstery.
CIFF Guangzhou has unveiled a new visual identity to mark the trade fair’s 30th anniversary

The China International Furniture Fair (CIFF) Guangzhou has unveiled its 30th anniversary visual identity and outlined plans for its 2027 Home Furniture Exhibition, with new initiatives covering contemporary design, emerging lifestyles and retail opportunities.

The first phase of the fair, which focuses on home furniture, will take place from 18–21 Mar 2027. It will occupy 430,000 sq m across the Canton Fair Complex and Poly World Trade Centre, bringing together 2,700 exhibitors, including 285 first-time participants.
Under the theme New Voyage, Lead the Way, the exhibition will cover established furniture categories alongside emerging lifestyle segments and new sourcing opportunities.
CIFF Guangzhou will bring together commercial, designer and international brands for its Home Furniture Exhibition
The Contemporary Design Exhibition will span 40,000 sq m and feature more than 80 commercial design brands, over 20 designer brands and more than 20 international design brands.

A new Designer Sourcing Zone will provide a platform for domestic and international designers and project buyers. It will showcase concepts for future living spaces, with a focus on sustainability, technology and health.
Visitors explore home furnishings and decorative products at CIFF Guangzhou
The exhibition will cover established furniture and lifestyle segments, including soft furnishings, dining and living room furniture, home decor, and outdoor and leisure products.
The Soft Furnishings sector will introduce the NeoSmart theme and a Smart Eco-Innovation Zone, featuring products and solutions for smart and healthy living.
The Outdoor and Leisure sector will exceed 60,000 sq m for the first time, bringing together more than 460 brands to showcase outdoor products and lifestyle trends in international markets.
Bedroom furniture will feature among the products showcased at the Home Furniture Exhibition
Four dedicated zones will focus on emerging market segments: senior living, pet furniture, smart upholstery and new retail.
The Senior Living zone will present products and solutions across six scenarios, covering smart health and lifestyle needs among older consumers.
The Pet Home zone, under the theme Pets & Pal Living, will feature 50 brands and explore the integration of pet-friendly products into residential, outdoor and public spaces.
Spanning 10,000 sq m, the Smart Upholstery zone will focus on health-responsive materials and solutions, reflecting growing interest in functional and technology-enabled upholstered products.
The New Retail zone will examine new business models and the integration of online and offline sales channels.
